source_instruction: i am looking for travel foaming dispenser for hand soap. please choose rose gold and silver pump head.
query: Ugh, I just got back from walking my golden retriever and he rolled in a huge patch of clover right after I gave him a bath, I swear he does it on purpose to mess with me. Then I stopped to get an iced lavender latte on the way home and the barista put way too much syrup in it, it’s so cloying I can barely sip it, and I also realized I forgot to pick up the replacement lavender dryer sheets I needed last week. I’m looking for refillable containers that are rose gold with a silver pump head, at a good price point that makes sense for what I’m buying.
